item.title: Valentine’s Day reservations are filling up fast. Here are 10 Hall County restaurants perfect for date night
item.description: Dinner reservations are filling up fast for Valentine's Day.

item.title: How soon closing on Oakwood warehouse for ICE jail could take place
item.description: Oakwood officials are hearing secondhand that the U.S. government is poised to close soon on warehouse property to use as an ICE jail.

item.title: Oak Ridge Boys return to Gainesville. Here are the details
item.description: The Oak Ridge Boys will be returning to Gainesville after two years, bringing back their best country hits and boot-kicking tunes.

item.title: Your weekly guide of things to do in and around Hall County
item.description: Need last minute Valentine's plans? This week has plenty of local events to share with that special someone from wine tastings and girls' nights to flower arrangements and art. Here are our top five picks.

item.title: Retail building planned next to South Hall grocery store
item.description: A 16,250-square-foot retail building is proposed next to the Aldi grocery store off Spout Springs Road in South Hall.

item.title: Landscaping truck crashes into electrical transformer in downtown Gainesville
item.description: A landscaping truck struck an electrical transformer Monday afternoon next to the Hall County Library at the parking deck in downtown Gainesville.

item.title: Will distilled spirits sales be placed on the ballot? Here's what Hall commissioners said
item.description: The Hall County Board of Commissioners will vote on whether to place a referendum on the ballot to allow the sale of distilled spirits in the unincorporated areas of the county, according to a notice for a public hearing.

item.title: Jury selection begins in Hall for father of Apalachee High School shooting suspect
item.description: Jury selection began Monday in Hall County in the trial of Colin Gray, the father of a teenage student charged with carrying out the deadliest school shooting in Georgia's history.

item.title: Update: Video shows plane crash into cars on Browns Bridge Road
item.description: A single-engine plane crashed into multiple cars after making an emergency landing Monday near the intersection of Browns Bridge Road and Pearl Nix Parkway, according to police.

item.title: Planned ICE warehouse jail draws huge crowd at Oakwood City Council meeting
item.description: Area residents packed Oakwood City Hall Monday night to voice outrage that federal officials are moving to turn a local warehouse into an U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement jail.
